incarnation: Aetherion: Seven Laws of Magic — Lyra Hexwind current selected individual V2 portrait, original project canon2026
sourceLimits: Original project character: actual selected HEROES_DB V2 portrait and production.audiovisual portrait agree; internal visual authority, not external franchise canon.
One visible source view cannot certify hidden back construction, exact tiny ornament, unseen staff details or numerical age; conservative continuation only, no perfect1:1 certification.
Reference spell-focus visible architecture is locked; glyph effects are abstract cyan geometric diagrams, not readable text.
Old navy/black-haired unarmed atlas remains unchanged as a variant and does not qualify current identity.
CG05 is Nexus gameplay adaptation; CG09-11 Fan Art; CG12-15 What If. CG13 is clearly a gender interpretation; CG15 first study at same apparent age, no invented childhood.
